summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 1). It draws the top line A-D-M and bottom line B-P-C as straight strokes, plus solid edges A-B, A-P, A-C, D-P, D-C. Labels A, B, C, D, M, P are placed outside their vertices. The automatic Critic scored it 0.95 with no must-repair issues, and topology check passed with no missing edges.
